metadata.name: Chandigarh University & Gharuan Sector (Synthetic Demonstration Area)
metadata.description: Synthetic emergency access intelligence dataset for Chandigarh University (CU) Gharuan campus & surrounding rural-urban fringe, SAS Nagar Mohali. All features, road clearances, and bottlenecks are simulated for demonstration.
metadata.disclaimer: PROTOTYPE DEMONSTRATION ONLY. NOT AN OFFICIAL EMERGENCY-ACCESS ASSESSMENT.

properties.name: NH-05 Main University Arterial (Ludhiana-Chandigarh Hwy Access)
properties.notes: Divided wide corridor. Full clearance for standard fire tenders and heavy emergency apparatus.

properties.name: Academic Blocks Central Spine (North Campus Lane)
properties.notes: Standard single-lane paved road. Accessible to medium fire tenders and emergency ambulances.

properties.name: Old Gharuan Village Bypass Gully (Narrow Corridor)
properties.obstruction: Physical bottleneck: Road width is 2.1m (below standard 2.5m heavy vehicle clearance). Accessible only to QRV / two-wheelers.
properties.notes: Constrained corridor connecting village settlements. Standard fire tenders cannot enter. Relay hose or two-wheeler QRV required.

properties.name: Hostel Complex Cross Link (Simulated Obstruction)
properties.obstruction: Simulated immovable physical bollards & low sagging overhead optical/power cable bundle (< 2.2m clearance)
properties.notes: Completely impassable for four-wheeled emergency vehicles until overhead cables and security bollards are cleared.

properties.name: Gharuan East Rural By-lane (Unknown Width)
properties.notes: Width and overhead clearance are unmeasured in panchayat/municipal cadastral records. Ground truth audit required.

properties.name: Sports Arena & South Transit Spur
properties.notes: Direct connector south of campus arterial with clear lateral boundaries.
